name: Renfrewshire
title: Renfrewshire —
title_em: Paisley pattern and the home of Scottish thread.
tagline: Paisley's Abbey, the famous Paisley pattern and Glasgow Airport.
summary: Renfrewshire's main town is Paisley, which gave its name to the swirling Paisley pattern woven in its mills. Paisley Abbey is a medieval church with a rich history.
The area includes Glasgow Airport, Erskine, and the Gleniffer Braes above Paisley.
